exposure: Negative pressure wound therapy vs. abdominal dressing
cohort: 4,391 Black or White patients with obesity who underwent cesarean delivery
finding: Negative pressure wound therapy was associated with an increased risk of postoperative surgical site infection after cesarean delivery in obese patients, likely due to increased operative time.
mod_finding: This study found that negative pressure wound therapy following cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of surgical site infection in patients with obesity.
